query: What are the legal repercussions of assaulting someone at school?
reference_answer:
Assault in Educational Institutions:
Assault in educational institutions can lead to imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and other relevant laws, including the IPC.

Assault in Educational Institutions:
Assault in educational institutions can lead to imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and other relevant laws, including the IPC.

Assault with Sexual Intent:
The penalty for assault with sexual intent can range from 1-5 years imprisonment under Section 354 of the Indian Penal Code (IPC). Fines may also be imposed.

[Document 3]
Consequences for Assault with Minor Injuries:
Assault causing minor injuries can be punished with imprisonment up to 1 year or a fine up to ₹1,000, or both, under Section 323 of the IPC.

[Document 4]
Assault during Labor Disputes:
The penalty for assault during labor disputes can lead to imprisonment up to 3 years and/or a fine, under the Indian Penal Code (IPC) Section 325.

[Document 5]
Assaulting Persons with Disabilities:
The penalty for assaulting persons with disabilities can lead to imprisonment of up to 5 years and a fine, as per the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016.
answer: Legal repercussions of assaulting someone at school include up to 3 years imprisonment and a fine, under the Tamil Nadu Prohibition of Harassment of Women Act and IPC. Assaults with sexual intent can result in 1-5 years imprisonment and fines. Assaults causing minor injuries can lead to up to 1 year imprisonment or a fine of ₹1,000. Assaults during labor disputes can lead to up to 3 years imprisonment and fines. Assaulting persons with disabilities can lead to up to 5 years imprisonment and a fine. [Document 1]
